$comment: What scripts/live-run.mjs runs for this leaf. The fixtures are the leaf's own, copied from its fixtures directory; test_collection.py is extracted from the leaf's Automation scripts section. Setup builds what Lab steps 1, 2, 6 and 7 build - the venv the script needs, the runs, qrels-v2 and the leaky runs - so Commands 2-6 find the files they read; setup is scaffolding and never counted as coverage. Command 1 then runs over the existing venv, which pip reports as already satisfied.

setup.run: python3 -m venv .venv-eval && .venv-eval/bin/pip install --quiet ranx==0.3.21 ir-measures==0.4.3 rank_bm25==0.2.2
.venv-eval/bin/python test_collection.py runs fixtures/corpus.jsonl fixtures/queries.jsonl runs --synonyms fixtures/synonyms.json
.venv-eval/bin/python test_collection.py runs fixtures/corpus.jsonl fixtures/queries.jsonl runs-leaky --synonyms fixtures/synonyms-leaky.json
